pages.title: X-Ray Goggles
pages.text: String, a Netherite Ingot and two Breeze Crystals. Worn on the head.

pages.title: Seeing the scan
pages.text: With the goggles on, a scan draws every block it reported as a coloured box $(thing)through the rock$(), for about twelve seconds.$(br2)They show nothing on their own. Nothing is revealed that the detector did not already tell you: the boxes are exactly the blocks it just reported.

pages.title: Strain
pages.text: Each visualisation adds $(thing)20 strain$(), which bleeds off on its own. Cross $(thing)100$() and the goggles give you $(thing)Nausea$() and refuse to draw until they recover.$(br2)Hover them to see the number. The detector itself is never blocked, so the counts keep coming even when the picture will not.$(br2)Goggles wear by 1 per ore block reported while worn, and take Breeze Shards like the detector.

pages.title: Haste
pages.text: A scan that finds something also grants $(thing)Haste$() while the goggles are on, for twelve seconds.$(br2)$(thing)Haste II$() on a single loaded liquid, $(thing)Haste I$() on two or more. A focused tank sweeps the smallest volume of the three, so it gets the stronger hand.$(br2)Strain refuses it exactly as it refuses the highlight.
